text: Five things you must do in Iran, when it's safe again.
One. Stand in Nahgsh eh Jah hahn Square, in Ees fah hahn. A Yoo-nes-co site, built around sixteen hundred.
Two. Walk through Persepolis, the ceremonial capital of the Ah kee meh nid Empire.
Three. See the Pink Mosque, in Shih rahz, at sunrise.
Four. Look up inside the breeze catcher at Dowlat Ah bahd Garden, in Yezd. Almost thirty-four meters tall.
Five. Eat fah loo deh in Shih rahz. Frozen noodles, rose water, and lime. One of the world's oldest frozen desserts.
